title: Book Edition 2 revision B: tranche-B visuals (embedding, cache architecture, index/hot row, optimistic vs pessimistic)
source_handoff: owner-supplied external review of the Edition 2 PDF, visuals 2.2/2.4/2.5/2.6; plan approved 2026-09-24
acceptance_criteria: fig-embedded-vs-normalized is authored, registered, embedded in the Embedded documents family, labelled form x evidence status with a text equivalent, and contrasts Parent->many child rows with a bounded child collection inside the parent

fig-cache-read-copy is authored, registered, embedded at the head of the cache-consistency concept, and shows Client -> App -> {authoritative DB | non-authoritative cache read copy} with source-correctness vs copy-correctness annotations
fig-index-vs-hotrow is authored, registered, embedded in indexes-and-hot-rows, and shows a narrow index path beside many writers contending on one row

fig-optimistic-vs-pessimistic is authored, registered, embedded in concurrency-control, and shows the version-checked success/0-rows/retry path beside the lock-wait path, making the invariant recheck (not the lock) the step that rejects the invalidated operation
No figure embeds a rate or a figure number; every figure is a conceptual illustration with form structure or sequence
Page count is recorded before and after the tranche
book/assets/export.sh --check passes, book/evidence/check.sh passes, and a scratch book/build.sh preview verifies; no measured number or claim changed
expected_artifacts: four new tranche-B figure sources and assets
embedded figure-evidence calls with text equivalents
RESULT.md with Decision Log and the page-count record
